shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index rose 16 points or 0.20 percent on Tuesday to close at 8155 points.Leading the gains are STMicroelectronics (4.82%), Bureau Veritas (2.39%) and Essilor (2.32%).Top losers were Orange (-3.76%), AXA (-2.05%) and Societe Generale (-1.75%).
